errors.listing.staleConnection.explanati: Cmdr is trying to access this folder using an old reference that the server no longer recognises. This commonly happens with network drives (NFS, SMB) after the server restarts, the share is remounted, or the connection was interrupted.
errors.listing.cancelledErrno.title: Cancelled
errors.listing.cancelledErrno.explanatio: The operation was cancelled before it could finish.
errors.listing.diskFullErrno.suggestion:
Here's what to try:
- Free up space by moving or deleting files you no longer need
- Empty the Bin (right-click the Bin icon in the Dock)
- In Terminal, run `df -h` to see how much space is left on each volume
- Check **{system_settings} > General > Storage** for a breakdown of what's using space
errors.listing.cancelled.title: Cancelled
errors.listing.cancelled.explanation: The operation was cancelled before it could finish.
errors.listing.deviceReconnecting.explan: The connection to the device holding `{path}` restarted, so this action didn't go through. The device is still plugged in, and Cmdr is reopening it right now. This usually follows a cancelled or interrupted transfer.
